// diagnostic

E2203

`jet debug` can't step through this program yet — it uses a feature outside the safe interpreter boundary (a task/channel, `extern rust`/C FFI, an `#Unsafe`/`core.mem` region, or a native-only core module such as files/clock/random/environment/process).

What

`jet debug` can't step through this program yet — it uses a feature outside the safe interpreter boundary (a task/channel, `extern rust`/C FFI, an `#Unsafe`/`core.mem` region, or a native-only core module such as files/clock/random/environment/process).

Why

The interpreter debugger cannot model threads, foreign code, raw memory, or host state. The native `jet debug` CLI normally selects the LLDB backend for this program.

Fix

use the native `jet debug <file>` path with LLDB installed, or use `jet run <file>` when native debugging is unavailable.
